vulg: Petrus apostolus Iesu Christi electis advenis dispersionis Ponti Galatiae Cappadociae Asiae et Bithyniae
clem: Petrus Apostolus Jesu Christi, electis advenis dispersionis Ponti, Galati, Cappadoci, Asi, et Bithyni,
tr: πετρος αποστολος ιησου χριστου εκλεκτοις παρεπιδημοις διασπορας ποντου γαλατιας καππαδοκιας ασιας και βιθυνιας
kjv: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

vulg: secundum praescientiam Dei Patris in sanctificatione Spiritus in oboedientiam et aspersionem sanguinis Iesu Christi gratia vobis et pax multiplicetur
clem: secundum prscientiam Dei Patris, in sanctificationem Spiritus, in obedientiam, et aspersionem sanguinis Jesu Christi. Gratia vobis, et pax multiplicetur.
tr: κατα προγνωσιν θεου πατρος εν αγιασμω πνευματος εις υπακοην και ραντισμον αιματος ιησου χριστου χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη πληθυνθειη
kjv: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

vulg: benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi qui secundum magnam misericordiam suam regeneravit nos in spem vivam per resurrectionem Iesu Christi ex mortuis
clem: Benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, qui secundum misericordiam suam magnam regeneravit nos in spem vivam, per resurrectionem Jesu Christi ex mortuis,
tr: ευλογητος ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο κατα το πολυ αυτου ελεος αναγεννησας ημας εις ελπιδα ζωσαν δι αναστασεως ιησου χριστου εκ νεκρων
kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

vulg: in hereditatem incorruptibilem et incontaminatam et inmarcescibilem conservatam in caelis in vobis
clem: in hreditatem incorruptibilem, et incontaminatam, et immarcescibilem, conservatam in clis in vobis,
tr: εις κληρονομιαν αφθαρτον και αμιαντον και αμαραντον τετηρημενην εν ουρανοις εις ημας  υμας
kjv: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

vulg: qui in virtute Dei custodimini per fidem in salutem paratam revelari in tempore novissimo
clem: qui in virtute Dei custodimini per fidem in salutem, paratam revelari in tempore novissimo.
tr: τους εν δυναμει θεου φρουρουμενους δια πιστεως εις σωτηριαν ετοιμην αποκαλυφθηναι εν καιρω εσχατω
kjv: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

vulg: in quo exultatis modicum nunc si oportet contristati in variis temptationibus
clem: In quo exsultabis, modicum nunc si oportet contristari in variis tentationibus:
tr: εν ω  αγαλλιασθε ολιγον αρτι ει δεον εστιν λυπηθεντες εν ποικιλοις πειρασμοις
kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

vulg: ut probatum vestrae fidei multo pretiosius sit auro quod perit per ignem probato inveniatur in laudem et gloriam et honorem in revelatione Iesu Christi
clem: ut probatio vestr fidei multo pretiosior auro (quod per ignem probatur) inveniatur in laudem, et gloriam, et honorem in revelatione Jesu Christi:
tr: ινα το δοκιμιον υμων της πιστεως πολυ τιμιωτερον χρυσιου του απολλυμενου δια πυρος δε δοκιμαζομενου ευρεθη εις επαινον και τιμην και δοξαν εν αποκαλυψει ιησου χριστου
kjv: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

vulg: quem cum non videritis diligitis in quem nunc quoque non videntes credentes autem exultatis laetitia inenarrabili et glorificata
clem: quem cum non videritis, diligitis: in quem nunc quoque non videntes creditis: credentes autem exsultabitis ltitia inenarrabili, et glorificata:
tr: ον ουκ ειδοτες  ιδοντες  αγαπατε εις ον αρτι μη ορωντες πιστευοντες δε αγαλλιασθε χαρα ανεκλαλητω και δεδοξασμενη
kjv: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

vulg: reportantes finem fidei vestrae salutem animarum
clem: reportantes finem fidei vestr, salutem animarum.
tr: κομιζομενοι το τελος της πιστεως υμων σωτηριαν ψυχων
kjv: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

vulg: de qua salute exquisierunt atque scrutati sunt prophetae qui de futura in vobis gratia prophetaverunt
clem: De qua salute exquisierunt, atque scrutati sunt prophet, qui de futura in vobis gratia prophetaverunt:
tr: περι ης σωτηριας εξεζητησαν και εξηρευνησαν προφηται οι περι της εις υμας χαριτος προφητευσαντες
kjv: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

vulg: scrutantes in quod vel quale tempus significaret in eis Spiritus Christi praenuntians eas quae in Christo sunt passiones et posteriores glorias
clem: scrutantes in quod vel quale tempus significaret in eis Spiritus Christi: prnuntians eas qu in Christo sunt passiones, et posteriores glorias:
tr: ερευνωντες εις τινα η ποιον καιρον εδηλου το εν αυτοις πνευμα χριστου προμαρτυρομενον τα εις χριστον παθηματα και τας μετα ταυτα δοξας
kjv: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

vulg: quibus revelatum est quia non sibi ipsis vobis autem ministrabant ea quae nunc nuntiata sunt vobis per eos qui evangelizaverunt vos Spiritu Sancto misso de caelo in quae desiderant angeli prospicere
clem: quibus revelatum est quia non sibimetipsis, vobis autem ministrabant ea qu nunc nuntiata sunt vobis per eos qui evangelizaverunt vobis, Spiritu Sancto misso de clo, in quem desiderant angeli prospicere.
tr: οις απεκαλυφθη οτι ουχ εαυτοις ημιν δε διηκονουν αυτα α νυν ανηγγελη υμιν δια των ευαγγελισαμενων υμας εν πνευματι αγιω αποσταλεντι απ ουρανου εις α επιθυμουσιν αγγελοι παρακυψαι
kjv: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

vulg: propter quod succincti lumbos mentis vestrae sobrii perfecte sperate in eam quae offertur vobis gratiam in revelatione Iesu Christi
clem: Propter quod succincti lumbos mentis vestr, sobrii, perfecte sperate in eam, qu offertur vobis, gratiam, in revelationem Jesu Christi:
tr: διο αναζωσαμενοι τας οσφυας της διανοιας υμων νηφοντες τελειως ελπισατε επι την φερομενην υμιν χαριν εν αποκαλυψει ιησου χριστου
kjv: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

vulg: quasi filii oboedientiae non configurati prioribus ignorantiae vestrae desideriis
clem: quasi filii obedienti, non configurati prioribus ignoranti vestr desideriis:
tr: ως τεκνα υπακοης μη συσχηματιζομενοι ταις προτερον εν τη αγνοια υμων επιθυμιαις
kjv: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

vulg: sed secundum eum qui vocavit vos sanctum et ipsi sancti in omni conversatione sitis
clem: sed secundum eum qui vocavit vos, Sanctum: et ipsi in omni conversatione sancti sitis:
tr: αλλα κατα τον καλεσαντα υμας αγιον και αυτοι αγιοι εν παση αναστροφη γενηθητε
kjv: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

vulg: quoniam scriptum est sancti eritis quia ego sanctus sum
clem: quoniam scriptum est: Sancti eritis, quoniam ego sanctus sum.
tr: διοτι γεγραπται αγιοι γενεσθε οτι εγω αγιος ειμι
kjv: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

vulg: et si Patrem invocatis eum qui sine acceptione personarum iudicat secundum uniuscuiusque opus in timore incolatus vestri tempore conversamini
clem: Et si patrem invocatis eum, qui sine acceptione personarum judicat secundum uniuscujusque opus, in timore incolatus vestri tempore conversamini.
tr: και ει πατερα επικαλεισθε τον απροσωποληπτως κρινοντα κατα το εκαστου εργον εν φοβω τον της παροικιας υμων χρονον αναστραφητε
kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

vulg: scientes quod non corruptibilibus argento vel auro redempti estis de vana vestra conversatione paternae traditionis
clem: Scientes quod non corruptibilibus, auro vel argento, redempti estis de vana vestra conversatione patern traditionis:
tr: ειδοτες οτι ου φθαρτοις αργυριω η χρυσιω ελυτρωθητε εκ της ματαιας υμων αναστροφης πατροπαραδοτου
kjv: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

vulg: sed pretioso sanguine quasi agni incontaminati et inmaculati Christi
clem: sed pretioso sanguine quasi agni immaculati Christi, et incontaminati:
tr: αλλα τιμιω αιματι ως αμνου αμωμου και ασπιλου χριστου
kjv: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

vulg: praecogniti quidem ante constitutionem mundi manifestati autem novissimis temporibus propter vos
clem: prcogniti quidem ante mundi constitutionem, manifestati autem novissimis temporibus propter vos,
tr: προεγνωσμενου μεν προ καταβολης κοσμου φανερωθεντος δε επ εσχατων των χρονων δι υμας
kjv: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

vulg: qui per ipsum fideles estis in Deo qui suscitavit eum a mortuis et dedit ei gloriam ut fides vestra et spes esset in Deo
clem: qui per ipsum fideles estis in Deo, qui suscitavit eum a mortuis, et dedit ei gloriam, ut fides vestra et spes esset in Deo:
tr: τους δι αυτου πιστευοντας εις θεον τον εγειραντα αυτον εκ νεκρων και δοξαν αυτω δοντα ωστε την πιστιν υμων και ελπιδα ειναι εις θεον
kjv: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

vulg: animas vestras castificantes in oboedientia caritatis in fraternitatis amore simplici ex corde invicem diligite adtentius
clem: animas vestras castificantes in obedientia caritatis, in fraternitatis amore, simplici ex corde invicem diligite attentius:
tr: τας ψυχας υμων ηγνικοτες εν τη υπακοη της αληθειας δια πνευματος εις φιλαδελφιαν ανυποκριτον εκ καθαρας καρδιας αλληλους αγαπησατε εκτενως
kjv: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

vulg: renati non ex semine corruptibili sed incorruptibili per verbum Dei vivi et permanentis
clem: renati non ex semine corruptibili, sed incorruptibili per verbum Dei vivi, et permanentis in ternum:
tr: αναγεγεννημενοι ουκ εκ σπορας φθαρτης αλλα αφθαρτου δια λογου ζωντος θεου και μενοντος εις τον αιωνα
kjv: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

vulg: quia omnis caro ut faenum et omnis gloria eius tamquam flos faeni exaruit faenum et flos decidit
clem: quia omnis caro ut fnum: et omnis gloria ejus tamquam flos fni: exaruit fnum, et flos ejus decidit.
tr: διοτι πασα σαρξ ως χορτος και πασα δοξα ανθρωπου ως ανθος χορτου εξηρανθη ο χορτος και το ανθος αυτου εξεπεσεν
kjv: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

vulg: verbum autem Domini manet in aeternum hoc est autem verbum quod evangelizatum est in vos
clem: Verbum autem Domini manet in ternum: hoc est autem verbum, quod evangelizatum est in vos.
tr: το δε ρημα κυριου μενει εις τον αιωνα τουτο δε εστιν το ρημα το ευαγγελισθεν εις υμας
kjv: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

vulg: deponentes igitur omnem malitiam et omnem dolum et simulationes et invidias et omnes detractiones
clem: Deponentes igitur omnem malitiam, et omnem dolum, et simulationes, et invidias, et omnes detractiones,
tr: αποθεμενοι ουν πασαν κακιαν και παντα δολον και υποκρισεις και φθονους και πασας καταλαλιας
kjv: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

vulg: sicut modo geniti infantes rationale sine dolo lac concupiscite ut in eo crescatis in salutem
clem: sicut modo geniti infantes, rationabile, sine dolo lac concupiscite: ut in eo crescatis in salutem:
tr: ως αρτιγεννητα βρεφη το λογικον αδολον γαλα επιποθησατε ινα εν αυτω αυξηθητε
kjv: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

vulg: si gustastis quoniam dulcis Dominus
clem: si tamen gustastis quoniam dulcis est Dominus.
tr: ειπερ εγευσασθε οτι χρηστος ο κυριος
kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

vulg: ad quem accedentes lapidem vivum ab hominibus quidem reprobatum a Deo autem electum honorificatum
clem: Ad quem accedentes lapidem vivum, ab hominibus quidem reprobatum, a Deo autem electum, et honorificatum:
tr: προς ον προσερχομενοι λιθον ζωντα υπο ανθρωπων μεν αποδεδοκιμασμενον παρα δε θεω εκλεκτον εντιμον
kjv: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

vulg: et ipsi tamquam lapides vivi superaedificamini domus spiritalis sacerdotium sanctum offerre spiritales hostias acceptabiles Deo per Iesum Christum
clem: et ipsi tamquam lapides vivi superdificamini, domus spiritualis, sacerdotium sanctum, offerre spirituales hostias, acceptabiles Deo per Jesum Christum.
tr: και αυτοι ως λιθοι ζωντες οικοδομεισθε οικος πνευματικος ιερατευμα αγιον ανενεγκαι πνευματικας θυσιας ευπροσδεκτους τω θεω δια ιησου χριστου
kjv: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

vulg: propter quod continet in scriptura ecce pono in Sion lapidem summum angularem electum pretiosum et qui crediderit in eo non confundetur
clem: Propter quod continet Scriptura: Ecce pono in Sion lapidem summum angularem, electum, pretiosum: et qui crediderit in eum, non confundetur.
tr: διο και περιεχει εν τη γραφη ιδου τιθημι εν σιων λιθον ακρογωνιαιον εκλεκτον εντιμον και ο πιστευων επ αυτω ου μη καταισχυνθη
kjv: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

vulg: vobis igitur honor credentibus non credentibus autem lapis quem reprobaverunt aedificantes hic factus est in caput anguli
clem: Vobis igitur honor credentibus: non credentibus autem lapis, quem reprobaverunt dificantes: hic factus est in caput anguli,
tr: υμιν ουν η τιμη τοις πιστευουσιν απειθουσιν δε λιθον ον απεδοκιμασαν οι οικοδομουντες ουτος εγενηθη εις κεφαλην γωνιας
kjv: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

vulg: et lapis offensionis et petra scandali qui offendunt verbo nec credunt in quod et positi sunt
clem: et lapis offensionis, et petra scandali, his qui offendunt verbo, nec credunt in quo et positi sunt.
tr: και λιθος προσκομματος και πετρα σκανδαλου οι προσκοπτουσιν τω λογω απειθουντες εις ο και ετεθησαν
kjv: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

vulg: vos autem genus electum regale sacerdotium gens sancta populus adquisitionis ut virtutes adnuntietis eius qui de tenebris vos vocavit in admirabile lumen suum
clem: Vos autem genus electum, regale sacerdotium, gens sancta, populus acquisitionis: ut virtutes annuntietis ejus qui de tenebris vos vocavit in admirabile lumen suum.
tr: υμεις δε γενος εκλεκτον βασιλειον ιερατευμα εθνος αγιον λαος εις περιποιησιν οπως τας αρετας εξαγγειλητε του εκ σκοτους υμας καλεσαντος εις το θαυμαστον αυτου φως
kjv: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light;

vulg: qui aliquando non populus nunc autem populus Dei qui non consecuti misericordiam nunc autem misericordiam consecuti
clem: Qui aliquando non populus, nunc autem populus Dei: qui non consecuti misericordiam, nunc autem misericordiam consecuti.
tr: οι ποτε ου λαος νυν δε λαος θεου οι ουκ ηλεημενοι νυν δε ελεηθεντες
kjv: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

vulg: carissimi obsecro tamquam advenas et peregrinos abstinere vos a carnalibus desideriis quae militant adversus animam
clem: Carissimi, obsecro vos tamquam advenas et peregrinos abstinere vos a carnalibus desideriis, qu militant adversus animam,
tr: αγαπητοι παρακαλω ως παροικους και παρεπιδημους απεχεσθαι των σαρκικων επιθυμιων αιτινες στρατευονται κατα της ψυχης
kjv: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

vulg: conversationem vestram inter gentes habentes bonam ut in eo quod detractant de vobis tamquam de malefactoribus ex bonis operibus considerantes glorificent Deum in die visitationis
clem: conversationem vestram inter gentes habentes bonam: ut in eo quod detrectant de vobis tamquam de malefactoribus, ex bonis operibus vos considerantes, glorificent Deum in die visitationis.
tr: την αναστροφην υμων εν τοις εθνεσιν εχοντες καλην ινα εν ω καταλαλουσιν υμων ως κακοποιων εκ των καλων εργων εποπτευσαντες δοξασωσιν τον θεον εν ημερα επισκοπης
kjv: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

vulg: subiecti estote omni humanae creaturae propter Dominum sive regi quasi praecellenti
clem: Subjecti igitur estote omni human creatur propter Deum: sive regi quasi prcellenti:
tr: υποταγητε ουν παση ανθρωπινη κτισει δια τον κυριον ειτε βασιλει ως υπερεχοντι
kjv: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

vulg: sive ducibus tamquam ab eo missis ad vindictam malefactorum laudem vero bonorum
clem: sive ducibus tamquam ab eo missis ad vindictam malefactorum, laudem vero bonorum:
tr: ειτε ηγεμοσιν ως δι αυτου πεμπομενοις εις εκδικησιν μεν κακοποιων επαινον δε αγαθοποιων
kjv: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

vulg: quia sic est voluntas Dei ut benefacientes obmutescere faciatis inprudentium hominum ignorantiam
clem: quia sic est voluntas Dei, ut benefacientes obmutescere faciatis imprudentium hominum ignorantiam:
tr: οτι ουτως εστιν το θελημα του θεου αγαθοποιουντας φιμουν την των αφρονων ανθρωπων αγνωσιαν
kjv: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

vulg: quasi liberi et non quasi velamen habentes malitiae libertatem sed sicut servi Dei
clem: quasi liberi, et non quasi velamen habentes maliti libertatem, sed sicut servi Dei.
tr: ως ελευθεροι και μη ως επικαλυμμα εχοντες της κακιας την ελευθεριαν αλλ ως δουλοι θεου
kjv: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

vulg: omnes honorate fraternitatem diligite Deum timete regem honorificate
clem: Omnes honorate: fraternitatem diligite: Deum timete: regem honorificate.
tr: παντας τιμησατε την αδελφοτητα αγαπατε τον θεον φοβεισθε τον βασιλεα τιματε
kjv: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

vulg: servi subditi in omni timore dominis non tantum bonis et modestis sed etiam discolis
clem: Servi, subditi estote in omni timore dominis, non tantum bonis et modestis, sed etiam dyscolis.
tr: οι οικεται υποτασσομενοι εν παντι φοβω τοις δεσποταις ου μονον τοις αγαθοις και επιεικεσιν αλλα και τοις σκολιοις
kjv: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

vulg: haec est enim gratia si propter conscientiam Dei sustinet quis tristitias patiens iniuste
clem: Hc est enim gratia, si propter Dei conscientiam sustinet qui tristitias, patiens injuste.
tr: τουτο γαρ χαρις ει δια συνειδησιν θεου υποφερει τις λυπας πασχων αδικως
kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

vulg: quae enim gloria est si peccantes et colaphizati suffertis sed si benefacientes et patientes sustinetis haec est gratia apud Deum
clem: Qu enim est gloria, si peccantes, et colaphizati suffertis? sed si bene facientes patienter sustinetis, hc est gratia apud Deum.
tr: ποιον γαρ κλεος ει αμαρτανοντες και κολαφιζομενοι υπομενειτε αλλ ει αγαθοποιουντες και πασχοντες υπομενειτε τουτο χαρις παρα θεω
kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

vulg: in hoc enim vocati estis quia et Christus passus est pro vobis vobis relinquens exemplum ut sequamini vestigia eius
clem: In hoc enim vocati estis: quia et Christus passus est pro nobis, vobis relinquens exemplum ut sequamini vestigia ejus:
tr: εις τουτο γαρ εκληθητε οτι και χριστος επαθεν υπερ ημων ημιν υπολιμπανων υπογραμμον ινα επακολουθησητε τοις ιχνεσιν αυτου
kjv: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

vulg: qui peccatum non fecit nec inventus est dolus in ore ipsius
clem: qui peccatum non fecit, nec inventus est dolus in ore ejus:
tr: ος αμαρτιαν ουκ εποιησεν ουδε ευρεθη δολος εν τω στοματι αυτου
kjv: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

vulg: qui cum malediceretur non maledicebat cum pateretur non comminabatur tradebat autem iudicanti se iniuste
clem: qui cum malediceretur, non maledicebat: cum pateretur, non comminabatur: tradebat autem judicanti se injuste:
tr: ος λοιδορουμενος ουκ αντελοιδορει πασχων ουκ ηπειλει παρεδιδου δε τω κρινοντι δικαιως
kjv: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

vulg: qui peccata nostra ipse pertulit in corpore suo super lignum ut peccatis mortui iustitiae viveremus cuius livore sanati estis
clem: qui peccata nostra ipse pertulit in corpore suo super lignum; ut peccatis mortui, justiti vivamus: cujus livore sanatis estis.
tr: ος τας αμαρτιας ημων αυτος ανηνεγκεν εν τω σωματι αυτου επι το ξυλον ινα ταις αμαρτιαις απογενομενοι τη δικαιοσυνη ζησωμεν ου τω μωλωπι αυτου ιαθητε
kjv: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

vulg: eratis enim sicut oves errantes sed conversi estis nunc ad pastorem et episcopum animarum vestrarum
clem: Eratis enim sicut oves errantes, sed conversi estis nunc ad pastorem, et episcopum animarum vestrarum.
tr: ητε γαρ ως προβατα πλανωμενα αλλ επεστραφητε νυν επι τον ποιμενα και επισκοπον των ψυχων υμων
kjv: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

vulg: similiter mulieres subditae suis viris ut et si qui non credunt verbo per mulierum conversationem sine verbo lucri fiant
clem: Similiter et mulieres subdit sint viris suis: ut etsi qui non credunt verbo, per mulierem conversationem sine verbo lucrifiant:
tr: ομοιως αι γυναικες υποτασσομεναι τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν ινα και ει τινες απειθουσιν τω λογω δια της των γυναικων αναστροφης ανευ λογου κερδηθησωνται
kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

vulg: considerantes in timore castam conversationem vestram
clem: considerantes in timore castam conversationem vestram.
tr: εποπτευσαντες την εν φοβω αγνην αναστροφην υμων
kjv: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.

vulg: quarum sit non extrinsecus capillaturae aut circumdatio auri aut indumenti vestimentorum cultus
clem: Quarum non sit extrinsecus capillatura, aut circumdatio auri, aut indumenti vestimentorum cultus:
tr: ων εστω ουχ ο εξωθεν εμπλοκης τριχων και περιθεσεως χρυσιων η ενδυσεως ιματιων κοσμος
kjv: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

vulg: sed qui absconditus cordis est homo in incorruptibilitate quieti et modesti spiritus quod est in conspectu Dei locuples
clem: sed qui absconditus est cordis homo, in incorruptibilitate quieti, et modesti spiritus, qui est in conspectu Dei locuples.
tr: αλλ ο κρυπτος της καρδιας ανθρωπος εν τω αφθαρτω του πραεος και ησυχιου πνευματος ο εστιν ενωπιον του θεου πολυτελες
kjv: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

vulg: sic enim aliquando et sanctae mulieres sperantes in Deo ornabant se subiectae propriis viris
clem: Sic enim aliquando et sanct mulieres, sperantes in Deo, ornabant se, subject propriis viris.
tr: ουτως γαρ ποτε και αι αγιαι γυναικες αι ελπιζουσαι επι τον θεον εκοσμουν εαυτας υποτασσομεναι τοις ιδιοις ανδρασιν
kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

vulg: sicut Sarra oboediebat Abrahae dominum eum vocans cuius estis filiae benefacientes et non timentes ullam perturbationem
clem: Sicut Sara obediebat Abrah, dominum eum vocans: cujus estis fili benefacientes, et non pertimentes ullam perturbationem.
tr: ως σαρρα υπηκουσεν τω αβρααμ κυριον αυτον καλουσα ης εγενηθητε τεκνα αγαθοποιουσαι και μη φοβουμεναι μηδεμιαν πτοησιν
kjv: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

vulg: viri similiter cohabitantes secundum scientiam quasi infirmiori vaso muliebri inpertientes honorem tamquam et coheredibus gratiae vitae uti ne inpediantur orationes vestrae
clem: Viri similiter cohabitantes secundum scientiam, quasi infirmiori vasculo muliebri impartientes honorem, tamquam et cohredibus grati vit: ut non impediantur orationes vestr.
tr: οι ανδρες ομοιως συνοικουντες κατα γνωσιν ως ασθενεστερω σκευει τω γυναικειω απονεμοντες τιμην ως και συγκληρονομοι χαριτος ζωης εις το μη εκκοπτεσθαι τας προσευχας υμων
kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

vulg: in fine autem omnes unianimes conpatientes fraternitatis amatores misericordes humiles
clem: In fine autem omnes unanimes, compatientes fraternitatis amatores, misericordes, modesti, humiles:
tr: το δε τελος παντες ομοφρονες συμπαθεις φιλαδελφοι ευσπλαγχνοι φιλοφρονες
kjv: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

vulg: non reddentes malum pro malo vel maledictum pro maledicto sed e contrario benedicentes quia in hoc vocati estis ut benedictionem hereditate possideatis
clem: non reddentes malum pro malo, nec maledictum pro maledicto, sed e contrario benedicentes: quia in hoc vocati estis, ut benedictionem hreditate possideatis.
tr: μη αποδιδοντες κακον αντι κακου η λοιδοριαν αντι λοιδοριας τουναντιον δε ευλογουντες ειδοτες οτι εις τουτο εκληθητε ινα ευλογιαν κληρονομησητε
kjv: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

vulg: qui enim vult vitam diligere et videre dies bonos coerceat linguam suam a malo et labia eius ne loquantur dolum
clem: Qui enim vult vitam diligere, et dies videre bonos, corceat linguam suam a malo, et labia ejus ne loquantur dolum.
tr: ο γαρ θελων ζωην αγαπαν και ιδειν ημερας αγαθας παυσατω την γλωσσαν αυτου απο κακου και χειλη αυτου του μη λαλησαι δολον
kjv: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

vulg: declinet autem a malo et faciat bonum inquirat pacem et persequatur eam
clem: Declinet a malo, et faciat bonum: inquirat pacem, et sequatur eam:
tr: εκκλινατω απο κακου και ποιησατω αγαθον ζητησατω ειρηνην και διωξατω αυτην
kjv: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

vulg: quia oculi Domini super iustos et aures eius in preces eorum vultus autem Domini super facientes mala
clem: quia oculi Domini super justos, et aures ejus in preces eorum: vultus autem Domini super facientes mala.
tr: οτι οι οφθαλμοι κυριου επι δικαιους και ωτα αυτου εις δεησιν αυτων προσωπον δε κυριου επι ποιουντας κακα
kjv: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

vulg: et quis est qui vobis noceat si boni aemulatores fueritis
clem: Et quis est qui vobis noceat, si boni mulatores fueritis?
tr: και τις ο κακωσων υμας εαν του αγαθου μιμηται γενησθε
kjv: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

vulg: sed et si quid patimini propter iustitiam beati timorem autem eorum ne timueritis et non conturbemini
clem: Sed et si quid patimini propter justitiam, beati. Timorem autem eorum ne timueritis, et non conturbemini.
tr: αλλ ει και πασχοιτε δια δικαιοσυνην μακαριοι τον δε φοβον αυτων μη φοβηθητε μηδε ταραχθητε
kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

vulg: Dominum autem Christum sanctificate in cordibus vestris parati semper ad satisfactionem omni poscenti vos rationem de ea quae in vobis est spe
clem: Dominum autem Christum sanctificate in cordibus vestris, parati semper ad satisfactionem omni poscenti vos rationem de ea, qu in vobis est, spe.
tr: κυριον δε τον θεον αγιασατε εν ταις καρδιαις υμων ετοιμοι δε αει προς απολογιαν παντι τω αιτουντι υμας λογον περι της εν υμιν ελπιδος μετα πραυτητος και φοβου
kjv: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

vulg: sed cum modestia et timore conscientiam habentes bonam ut in eo quod detrahunt vobis confundantur qui calumniantur vestram bonam in Christo conversationem
clem: Sed cum modestia, et timore, conscientiam habentes bonam: ut in eo, quod detrahunt vobis, confundantur, qui calumniantur vestram bonam in Christo conversationem.
tr: συνειδησιν εχοντες αγαθην ινα εν ω καταλαλωσιν υμων ως κακοποιων καταισχυνθωσιν οι επηρεαζοντες υμων την αγαθην εν χριστω αναστροφην
kjv: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

vulg: melius est enim benefacientes si velit voluntas Dei pati quam malefacientes
clem: Melius est enim benefacientes (si voluntas Dei velit) pati, quam malefacientes.
tr: κρειττον γαρ αγαθοποιουντας ει θελει το θελημα του θεου πασχειν η κακοποιουντας
kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

vulg: quia et Christus semel pro peccatis mortuus est iustus pro iniustis ut nos offerret Deo mortificatus carne vivificatus autem spiritu
clem: Quia et Christus semel pro peccatis nostris mortuus est, justus pro injustis, ut nos offerret Deo, mortificatus quidem carne, vivificatus autem spiritu.
tr: οτι και χριστος απαξ περι αμαρτιων επαθεν δικαιος υπερ αδικων ινα ημας προσαγαγη τω θεω θανατωθεις μεν σαρκι ζωοποιηθεις δε τω πνευματι
kjv: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

vulg: in quo et his qui in carcere erant spiritibus veniens praedicavit
clem: In quo et his, qui in carcere erant, spiritibus veniens prdicavit:
tr: εν ω και τοις εν φυλακη πνευμασιν πορευθεις εκηρυξεν
kjv: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

vulg: qui increduli fuerant aliquando quando expectabat Dei patientia in diebus Noe cum fabricaretur arca in qua pauci id est octo animae salvae factae sunt per aquam
clem: qui increduli fuerant aliquando, quando exspectabant Dei patientiam in diebus No, cum fabricaretur arca: in qua pauci, id est octo anim, salv fact sunt per aquam.
tr: απειθησασιν ποτε οτε απαξ εξεδεχετο η του θεου μακροθυμια εν ημεραις νωε κατασκευαζομενης κιβωτου εις ην ολιγαι τουτ εστιν οκτω ψυχαι διεσωθησαν δι υδατος
kjv: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

vulg: quod et vos nunc similis formae salvos facit baptisma non carnis depositio sordium sed conscientiae bonae interrogatio in Deum per resurrectionem Iesu Christi
clem: Quod et vos nunc similis form salvos fecit baptisma: non carnis depositio sordium, sed conscienti bon interrogatio in Deum per resurrectionem Jesu Christi.
tr: ο  ω  και ημας αντιτυπον νυν σωζει βαπτισμα ου σαρκος αποθεσις ρυπου αλλα συνειδησεως αγαθης επερωτημα εις θεον δι αναστασεως ιησου χριστου
kjv: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

vulg: qui est in dextera Dei profectus in caelum subiectis sibi angelis et potestatibus et virtutibus
clem: Qui est in dextera Dei, deglutiens mortem ut vit tern hredes efficeremur: profectus in clum subjectis sibi angelis, et potestatibus, et virtutibus.
tr: ος εστιν εν δεξια του θεου πορευθεις εις ουρανον υποταγεντων αυτω αγγελων και εξουσιων και δυναμεων
kjv: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

vulg: Christo igitur passo in carne et vos eadem cogitatione armamini quia qui passus est carne desiit a peccatis
clem: Christo igitur passo in carne, et vos eadem cogitatione armamini: quia qui passus est in carne, desiit a peccatis:
tr: χριστου ουν παθοντος υπερ ημων σαρκι και υμεις την αυτην εννοιαν οπλισασθε οτι ο παθων εν σαρκι πεπαυται αμαρτιας
kjv: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

vulg: ut iam non hominum desideriis sed voluntate Dei quod reliquum est in carne vivat temporis
clem: ut jam non desideriis hominum, sed voluntati Dei, quod reliquum est in carne vivat temporis.
tr: εις το μηκετι ανθρωπων επιθυμιαις αλλα θεληματι θεου τον επιλοιπον εν σαρκι βιωσαι χρονον
kjv: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

vulg: sufficit enim praeteritum tempus ad voluntatem gentium consummandam qui ambulaverunt in luxuriis desideriis vinolentiis comesationibus potationibus et inlicitis idolorum cultibus
clem: Sufficit enim prteritum tempus ad voluntatem gentium consummandam his qui ambulaverunt in luxuriis, desideriis, vinolentiis, comessationibus, potationibus, et illicitis idolorum cultibus.
tr: αρκετος γαρ ημιν ο παρεληλυθως χρονος του βιου το θελημα των εθνων κατεργασασθαι πεπορευμενους εν ασελγειαις επιθυμιαις οινοφλυγιαις κωμοις ποτοις και αθεμιτοις ειδωλολατρειαις
kjv: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

vulg: in quo peregrinantur non concurrentibus vobis in eandem luxuriae confusionem blasphemantes
clem: In quo admirantur non concurrentibus vobis in eamdem luxuri confusionem, blasphemantes.
tr: εν ω ξενιζονται μη συντρεχοντων υμων εις την αυτην της ασωτιας αναχυσιν βλασφημουντες
kjv: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

vulg: qui reddent rationem ei qui paratus est iudicare vivos et mortuos
clem: Qui reddent rationem ei qui paratus est judicare vivos et mortuos.
tr: οι αποδωσουσιν λογον τω ετοιμως εχοντι κριναι ζωντας και νεκρους
kjv: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

vulg: propter hoc enim et mortuis evangelizatum est ut iudicentur quidem secundum homines in carne vivant autem secundum Deum spiritu
clem: Propter hoc enim et mortuis evangelizatum est: ut judicentur quidem secundum homines in carne, vivant autem secundum Deum in spiritu.
tr: εις τουτο γαρ και νεκροις ευηγγελισθη ινα κριθωσιν μεν κατα ανθρωπους σαρκι ζωσιν δε κατα θεον πνευματι
kjv: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

vulg: omnium autem finis adpropinquavit estote itaque prudentes et vigilate in orationibus
clem: Omnium autem finis appropinquavit. Estote itaque prudentes, et vigilate in orationibus.
tr: παντων δε το τελος ηγγικεν σωφρονησατε ουν και νηψατε εις τας προσευχας
kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

vulg: ante omnia mutuam in vosmet ipsos caritatem continuam habentes quia caritas operit multitudinem peccatorum
clem: Ante omnia autem, mutuam in vobismetipsis caritatem continuam habentes: quia caritas operit multitudinem peccatorum.
tr: προ παντων δε την εις εαυτους αγαπην εκτενη εχοντες οτι  η  αγαπη καλυψει πληθος αμαρτιων
kjv: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

vulg: hospitales invicem sine murmuratione
clem: Hospitales invicem sine murmuratione.
tr: φιλοξενοι εις αλληλους ανευ γογγυσμων
kjv: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

vulg: unusquisque sicut accepit gratiam in alterutrum illam administrantes sicut boni dispensatores multiformis gratiae Dei
clem: Unusquisque, sicut accepit gratiam, in alterutrum illam administrantes, sicut boni dispensatores multiformis grati Dei.
tr: εκαστος καθως ελαβεν χαρισμα εις εαυτους αυτο διακονουντες ως καλοι οικονομοι ποικιλης χαριτος θεου
kjv: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

vulg: si quis loquitur quasi sermones Dei si quis ministrat tamquam ex virtute quam administrat Deus ut in omnibus honorificetur Deus per Iesum Christum cui est gloria et imperium in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: Si quis loquitur, quasi sermones Dei: si quis ministrat, tamquam ex virtute, quam administrat Deus: ut in omnibus honorificetur Deus per Jesum Christum: cui est gloria et imperium in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: ει τις λαλει ως λογια θεου ει τις διακονει ως εξ ισχυος ης χορηγει ο θεος ινα εν πασιν δοξαζηται ο θεος δια ιησου χριστου ω εστιν η δοξα και το κρατος εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: carissimi nolite peregrinari in fervore qui ad temptationem vobis fit quasi novi aliquid vobis contingat
clem: Carissimi, nolite peregrinari in fervore, qui ad tentationem vobis fit, quasi novi aliquid vobis contingat:
tr: αγαπητοι μη ξενιζεσθε τη εν υμιν πυρωσει προς πειρασμον υμιν γινομενη ως ξενου υμιν συμβαινοντος
kjv: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

vulg: sed communicantes Christi passionibus gaudete ut et in revelatione gloriae eius gaudeatis exultantes
clem: sed communicantes Christi passionibus gaudete, ut et in revelatione glori ejus gaudeatis exsultantes.
tr: αλλα καθο κοινωνειτε τοις του χριστου παθημασιν χαιρετε ινα και εν τη αποκαλυψει της δοξης αυτου χαρητε αγαλλιωμενοι
kjv: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

vulg: si exprobramini in nomine Christi beati quoniam gloriae Dei Spiritus in vobis requiescit
clem: Si exprobramini in nomine Christi, beati eritis: quoniam quod est honoris, glori, et virtutis Dei, et qui est ejus Spiritus, super vos requiescit.
tr: ει ονειδιζεσθε εν ονοματι χριστου μακαριοι οτι το της δοξης και το του θεου πνευμα εφ υμας αναπαυεται κατα μεν αυτους βλασφημειται κατα δε υμας δοξαζεται
kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

vulg: nemo enim vestrum patiatur quasi homicida aut fur aut maledicus aut alienorum appetitor
clem: Nemo autem vestrum patiatur ut homicida, aut fur, aut maledicus, aut alienorum appetitor.
tr: μη γαρ τις υμων πασχετω ως φονευς η κλεπτης η κακοποιος η ως αλλοτριοεπισκοπος
kjv: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

vulg: si autem ut Christianus non erubescat glorificet autem Deum in isto nomine
clem: Si autem ut christianus, non erubescat: glorificet autem Deum in isto nomine:
tr: ει δε ως χριστιανος μη αισχυνεσθω δοξαζετω δε τον θεον εν τω μερει τουτω
kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

vulg: quoniam tempus ut incipiat iudicium de domo Dei si autem primum a nobis qui finis eorum qui non credunt Dei evangelio
clem: quoniam tempus est ut incipiat judicium a domo Dei. Si autem primum a nobis, quis finis eorum, qui non credunt Dei Evangelio?
tr: οτι ο καιρος του αρξασθαι το κριμα απο του οικου του θεου ει δε πρωτον αφ ημων τι το τελος των απειθουντων τω του θεου ευαγγελιω
kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

vulg: et si iustus vix salvatur impius et peccator ubi parebit
clem: et si justus vix salvabitur, impius et peccator ubi parebunt?
tr: και ει ο δικαιος μολις σωζεται ο ασεβης και αμαρτωλος που φανειται
kjv: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

vulg: itaque et hii qui patiuntur secundum voluntatem Dei fideli creatori commendant animas suas in benefactis
clem: Itaque et hi, qui patiuntur secundum voluntatem Dei, fideli Creatori commendent animas suas in benefactis.
tr: ωστε και οι πασχοντες κατα το θελημα του θεου ως πιστω κτιστη παρατιθεσθωσαν τας ψυχας εαυτων εν αγαθοποιια
kjv: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

vulg: seniores ergo qui in vobis sunt obsecro consenior et testis Christi passionum qui et eius quae in futuro revelanda est gloriae communicator
clem: Seniores ergo, qui in vobis sunt, obsecro, consenior et testis Christi passionum: qui et ejus, qu in futuro revelanda est, glori communicator:
tr: πρεσβυτερους τους εν υμιν παρακαλω ο συμπρεσβυτερος και μαρτυς των του χριστου παθηματων ο και της μελλουσης αποκαλυπτεσθαι δοξης κοινωνος
kjv: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

vulg: pascite qui est in vobis gregem Dei providentes non coacto sed spontanee secundum Deum neque turpis lucri gratia sed voluntarie
clem: pascite qui in vobis est gregem Dei, providentes non coacte, sed spontanee secundum Deum: neque turpis lucri gratia, sed voluntarie:
tr: ποιμανατε το εν υμιν ποιμνιον του θεου επισκοπουντες μη αναγκαστως αλλ εκουσιως μηδε αισχροκερδως αλλα προθυμως
kjv: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

vulg: neque ut dominantes in cleris sed formae facti gregi et ex animo
clem: neque ut dominantes in cleris, sed forma facti gregis ex animo.
tr: μηδ ως κατακυριευοντες των κληρων αλλα τυποι γινομενοι του ποιμνιου
kjv: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being examples to the flock.

vulg: et cum apparuerit princeps pastorum percipietis inmarcescibilem gloriae coronam
clem: Et cum apparuerit princeps pastorum, percipietis immarcescibilem glori coronam.
tr: και φανερωθεντος του αρχιποιμενος κομιεισθε τον αμαραντινον της δοξης στεφανον
kjv: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

vulg: similiter adulescentes subditi estote senioribus omnes autem invicem humilitatem insinuate quia Deus superbis resistit humilibus autem dat gratiam
clem: Similiter adolescentes subditi estote senioribus. Omnes autem invicem humilitatem insinuate, quia Deus superbis resistit, humilibus autem dat gratiam.
tr: ομοιως νεωτεροι υποταγητε πρεσβυτεροις παντες δε αλληλοις υποτασσομενοι την ταπεινοφροσυνην εγκομβωσασθε οτι ο θεος υπερηφανοις αντιτασσεται ταπεινοις δε διδωσιν χαριν
kjv: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

vulg: humiliamini igitur sub potenti manu Dei ut vos exaltet in tempore visitationis
clem: Humiliamini igitur sub potenti manu Dei, ut vos exaltet in tempore visitationis:
tr: ταπεινωθητε ουν υπο την κραταιαν χειρα του θεου ινα υμας υψωση εν καιρω
kjv: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

vulg: omnem sollicitudinem vestram proicientes in eum quoniam ipsi cura est de vobis
clem: omnem sollicitudinem vestram projicientes in eum, quoniam ipsi cura est de vobis.
tr: πασαν την μεριμναν υμων επιρριψαντες επ αυτον οτι αυτω μελει περι υμων
kjv: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

vulg: sobrii estote vigilate quia adversarius vester diabolus tamquam leo rugiens circuit quaerens quem devoret
clem: Sobrii estote, et vigilate: quia adversarius vester diabolus tamquam leo rugiens circuit, qurens quem devoret:
tr: νηψατε γρηγορησατε οτι ο αντιδικος υμων διαβολος ως λεων ωρυομενος περιπατει ζητων τινα καταπιη
kjv: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

vulg: cui resistite fortes fide scientes eadem passionum ei quae in mundo est vestrae fraternitati fieri
clem: cui resistite fortes in fide: scientes eamdem passionem ei qu in mundo est vestr fraternitati fieri.
tr: ω αντιστητε στερεοι τη πιστει ειδοτες τα αυτα των παθηματων τη εν κοσμω υμων αδελφοτητι επιτελεισθαι
kjv: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

vulg: Deus autem omnis gratiae qui vocavit nos in aeternam suam gloriam in Christo Iesu modicum passos ipse perficiet confirmabit solidabit
clem: Deus autem omnis grati, qui vocavit nos in ternam suam gloriam in Christo Jesu, modicum passos ipse perficiet, confirmabit, solidabitque.
tr: ο δε θεος πασης χαριτος ο καλεσας ημας εις την αιωνιον αυτου δοξαν εν χριστω ιησου ολιγον παθοντας αυτος καταρτισαι υμας στηριξαι σθενωσαι θεμελιωσαι
kjv: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

vulg: ipsi imperium in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: Ipsi gloria, et imperium in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: αυτω η δοξα και το κρατος εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: per Silvanum vobis fidelem fratrem ut arbitror breviter scripsi obsecrans et contestans hanc esse veram gratiam Dei in qua state
clem: Per Silvanum fidelem fratrem vobis, ut arbitror, breviter scripsi: obsecrans et contestans, hanc esse veram gratiam Dei, in qua statis.
tr: δια σιλουανου υμιν του πιστου αδελφου ως λογιζομαι δι ολιγων εγραψα παρακαλων και επιμαρτυρων ταυτην ειναι αληθη χαριν του θεου εις ην εστηκατε
kjv: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

vulg: salutat vos quae est in Babylone cumelecta et Marcus filius meus
clem: Salutat vos ecclesia qu est in Babylone colecta, et Marcus filius meus.
tr: ασπαζεται υμας η εν βαβυλωνι συνεκλεκτη και μαρκος ο υιος μου
kjv: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

vulg: salutate invicem in osculo sancto gratia vobis omnibus qui estis in Christo
clem: Salutate invicem in osculo sancto. Gratia vobis omnibus qui estis in Christo Jesu. Amen.
tr: ασπασασθε αλληλους εν φιληματι αγαπης ειρηνη υμιν πασιν τοις εν χριστω ιησου αμην
kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
